strategies.name: fair_value_gap_trend_continuation_retest
strategies.entry_summary: Trade in the direction of the prevailing trend after a fair value gap forms from a three-candle imbalance that caused a break of structure. Wait for price to retrace back into that specific FVG—preferably one close to an order block—and enter on the tap/retest for continuation.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop loss just beyond the fair value gap: a little below the FVG for buys and a little above the FVG for sells. The transcript does not give a fixed profit-target rule, so management taught is essentially hold for continuation with the defined FVG-based stop.

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: wait for price to retrace into the bullish FVG that caused the break of structure
variants.transcript_quote: price will most likely come back mitigate the imbalance and keep pushing to the upside

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: wait for price to get back into the bearish FVG that caused the break of structure
variants.transcript_quote: patiently wait for you know price to get back into that FVG that caused the break of structure

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: prefer the FVG very close to the order block rather than any FVG on the chart
variants.transcript_quote: map out the FVG that cost the break of structure the FVG that is very close to the order block

result.enumeration_note: One runnable strategy is taught: FVG trend-continuation retest entries, with bullish/bearish directions and the order-block proximity preference treated as compatible variants rather than distinct strategies.
